![A Genos group chat with a thread open beside it](/lp/guide/en/chat.webp)

Search can find a message. It helps more when the work around it is connected.

```flow
Talk in a thread
Make it a task
Write it in the task's note
Ask Genos
```

Chat, tasks and notes live in one workspace, and Genos AI can answer from all three.
